summary: Repair governed Koru workflow and unpublished release discovery

delivery.outcome: Make Koru workflow aliases satisfy full governed admission, discover clean configured unpublished releases without treating outages as absence, preserve batch opt-outs and repair pip-less UV bootstrap.
nonGoals: No dependency or version changes; use the already integrated 2.2.6 after material repairs merge
No upload before independent source acceptance
No private or mixed-registry automatic publication
No queue/scheduler deployment or protected policy changes
No source-publication claim from process status or stale artifacts

architecture.decision: Reuse the typed registry observer for a read-only project release plan, with explicit source identity and no authority grant. Bare Koru workflow invocations select the complete existing workflow; preserve admission and dry-run behavior. Batch orchestration consumes plans and forwards effect-limiting flags. Initial clean merged publication uses its committed version only after authoritative package absence. UV pip targets the exact environment without lock-capable sync.
interfaceChanges: Bare -k and Koru push/batch invocations request the existing full workflow
Add read-only --project publication planning to the installed observer command
Batch includes configured clean pending releases and preserves caller effect opt-outs
architecture.rollback: Protected source revert; no data migration or authority policy change.

commands: goal -a on the independently merged clean base
